title: Tales pictures drawn by the chosen writer

clauses.text: A Tales story written by Claude Code has pictures drawn by Claude Code; they show the scene of the story and are not blank or one flat colour.

steps.do: In Tales, choose Claude Code as the writer for a short story with pictures, and wait until it finishes.
steps.expect: Each picture shows the scene of its part of the story with several colours and details. None is empty or a single flat colour.
